Parliament's Monsoon Session to Focus on Justice Yashwant Varma Report

The upcoming Monsoon Session of Parliament is expected to focus on the report related to Justice Yashwant Varma, who resigned in April after facing impeachment proceedings. The Speaker of the Lok Sabha has announced that the probe committee's report will be presented during the session. This development comes amidst a row over Rajnath Singh's 'lie' and a bill for CM and PM removal over 30-day jail.
